question: Ilang porsyento ng socialized housing ang kailangang i-comply ng mga subdivision developers sa ilalim ng PD 957?
answer:
Sa mga subdivision developer, kailangan nga 10% ng socialized housing ang i-comply sa ilalim ng PD 957. [S4]

Reference:
[S4] City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf | printed page 707 | chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0078-C001

ground_truth: Subdivision applications governed by Presidential Decree No. 957 are legally mandated to submit proof of compliance with the 10% socialized housing requirement as part of the documentary checklist for subdivision approval.
